blocks.text: Antibiotics woh dawaen hain jo bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki growth (barhotri) rok kar bacterial infection ka ilaaj karti hain. Antibiotics ki darja bandi (classification) zyada tar is baat par hoti hai ke woh kaise kaam karti hain (mechanism of action) aur un ki kimiyai banawat (chemical structure) kya hai. Chaar bari qismein yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Bacterial cell ka khaaka: hari moti cell wall, andar DNA ka chhalla jis par narangi enzyme (gyrase), surkh 'folate' dabba aur jamni ribosomes. Leader lines: PENICILLIN - cell wall (peptidoglycan), cross-links ruk kar wall phat jati hai; FLUOROQUINOLONES - DNA gyrase / topoisomerase IV phans kar DNA toot'ta hai; SULFONAMIDES - folate banna rukta hai; TETRACYCLINE - 30S ribosome subunit se jurti hai.
blocks.caption: Chaar antibiotic qismein bacterial cell mein kahan asar karti hain (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).
Chaar qismon ka muqabla
rows: DNA gyrase aur topoisomerase IV (DNA replication)

blocks.text: Bactericidal dawa bacteria ko maar deti hai (penicillin, fluoroquinolones). Bacteriostatic dawa bacteria ki growth aur afzaish (multiplication) rokti hai aur unhein khatam karne ka kaam immune system par chhorti hai (tetracycline, sulfonamides).
blocks.title: Bactericidal aur bacteriostatic

blocks.prompt: Antibiotics viruses par kyun kaam nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Antibiotics bacteria ke apne hisson par asar karti hain, jaise cell wall, 70S ribosomes, DNA gyrase aur folate banane ka raasta. Viruses mein yeh cheezen nahi hotin; woh host cell ke andar us ki machinery se barhte hain.

items: Antibiotics bacteria ko maarti (bactericidal) ya un ki growth rokti (bacteriostatic) hain.
Chaar qismein: penicillin, tetracycline, fluoroquinolones, sulfonamides.
